subject.title: feat(discord): add implicit reply mention policy

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `channels.discord.implicitReplyMentions` as the durable Discord-specific configuration contract, rather than fold this case into the broader multi-agent routing work?
rationale: The patch adds a persistent user-facing policy surface; the live proof establishes the problem and proposed behavior, but it cannot decide the long-term configuration boundary or its relationship to broader Discord routing policy.

options.title: Adopt the focused Discord policy
options.body: Approve the two-field Discord account policy, then require a rebase and current-main compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Fold it into routing policy work
options.body: Keep the underlying issue open and design reply targeting with the broader routing precedence work before adding another Discord configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt the focused Discord policy
recommendation.body: Approve the two-field Discord account policy, then require a rebase and current-main compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline directly connects this person to the initial policy proposal, while no stronger current-main ownership record was available in the supplied review evidence.
